source_en: Papers. Lasha Gagua, taxi, western district. Make it quick.
Nine years on these streets. Then your people closed half the routes.
Militsiya, Party, whoever put up these barriers. I don't care which.
Plenty. Half are [[whisper:fleeing to the exits]]. I charge double.
Last officer had a system. Checked once, waved me through.
Sure you do. Do it faster. Petrol's rationed, and so is my patience.
Wife and two kids, western block. They stay in. I drive.
City's sick, not dead. Not yet.
